title: Cabin Crew – Talent Pool
summary: Join the British Airways talent pool for future cabin crew opportunities based at London airports. Cabin crew deliver welcoming passenger service while following strict safety, security, and operational procedures. The work requires calm decisions under pressure, clear and empathetic communication, resilience, teamwork, and the flexibility to support travellers from many different backgrounds.
responsibilities: Deliver warm and professional service throughout each flight
Follow safety, security, and operational procedures
Adapt to different passenger needs and changing circumstances
Support colleagues and make clear decisions under pressure
required_qualifications: At least 12 months of customer service experience
Calm decision making in challenging situations
Right to work in the UK and unrestricted travel passport
preferred_qualifications: Experience serving customers from varied backgrounds
location_label: London Heathrow, Gatwick or London City, UK
